snippet.title: CURE - A Hospital Simulator - Early Access Trailer
snippet.description:
🎮 CURE - A Hospital Simulator
Build your hospital. Manage your staff. Treat your patients. Survive the chaos.

🏥 Get involved early!
We’re launching in Early Access, which means your feedback will directly help shape the future of the game. Join our growing community to share ideas, report bugs, and be part of the journey.

👥 Join the community on Discord: https://discord.gg/aR9CjkHFw2
🛒 Wishlist (and play soon) on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2786550/CURE__A_Hospital_Simulator/

💉 Build. Heal. Survive.
From managing staff and treating patients to dealing with unexpected challenges, it’s up to you to keep the hospital running smoothly, or watch the chaos unfold.

Whether you’re a master planner or just trying to keep your patients alive, CURE gives you the tools (and the pressure) to prove you’ve got what it takes.

#CUREGame #HospitalSimulator #EarlyAccess #IndieGame #SteamGame #Simulation #Gaming
